_comment: Manual overrides. For counties without a working scraper, you can add seed permit data here. Entries follow the same per-permit schema as scraped data. Useful for spot-checking the UI or maintaining critical-parcel watchlists by hand. Manual entries are merged into the per-county output file alongside scraped entries; manual entries WIN when permitNumber collides.
